ns2:section.sectionText: This course will open to all students in the Gies College of Business on Monday, November 18, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This course will open to Industrial & Enterprise Systems Engineering, General Engineering and Systems Engineering & Design and French Commercial students on Monday, November 25, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This section will open to all of campus to allow Business Minor and prospective Business Minor students the option to register for this elective not offered as an online option on Monday, December 2, 2019 at approximately 10:00 a.m. This is an elective course for undergraduate students pursuing the business minor.
